tagline: Your local guide to the Roof of Africa
about:
Jambo! I was born at the foot of Mount Kilimanjaro and have been guiding climbers to Uhuru Peak for many years. I know every route, every camp and every sunrise on this mountain. My team and I make sure you are safe, well fed and happy — from the first step in the rainforest to the top at 5,895 m.

Edit this text in the editor to tell your own story.
